y-m-65-08.title: Kusarudza chimiro chepasiwedhi yelokeri
y-m-65-08.goal: Enzanisa huwandu hwenyaya nokuwanza huwandu hwesarudzo dzenzvimbo yega yega, gadzira iwe pachako zvimiro zvinosangana nomuganho, uye utonge kuti huwandu hwenyaya hunochinja sei kana mamiriro achichinja.
y-m-65-08.material: Pasiwedhi yelokeri ine nzvimbo 5 zvose. Nzvimbo dzekutanga L mavara makuru echiRungu (sarudzo 26, A kusvika Z), uye nzvimbo D dzasara nhamba (sarudzo 10, 0 kusvika 9). Vara rimwe chete kana nhamba imwe chete zvinogona kushandiswa kakawanda. Chimiro chinosarudzwa na L+D=5, nenzvimbo dzamavara dzose kutanga uye nzvimbo dzenhamba shure.
y-m-65-08.thinking.0: Enzanisa huwandu hwenyaya dzemisanganiso yenzvimbo yakasiyana
y-m-65-08.thinking.1: Tsvaga zvimiro zvakati wandei mukati momuganho wemhando
y-m-65-08.prereq.2: Mamiriro: vara rimwe chete rinogona kudzokororwa, pane sarudzo 26 dzevara guru uye 10 dzenhamba. Pane nzvimbo 5, nenzvimbo dzamavara makuru kutanga uye nzvimbo dzenhamba shure
y-m-65-08.s.s1.prompt: (가) nzvimbo 2 dzamavara + nzvimbo 3 dzenhamba, (나) nzvimbo 3 dzamavara + nzvimbo 2 dzenhamba. Chimiro chipi chine mapasiwedhi akawanda anogoneka?
y-m-65-08.s.s1.hint.0: Pachimiro chega chega, nyora huwandu hwesarudzo dzenzvimbo yega yega.
y-m-65-08.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa nokuti huwandu hwesarudzo hunochinja nguva dzingani kana ukachinja nzvimbo imwe.
y-m-65-08.s.s1.o.a: Ndi (나). Ine nzvimbo imwe yevara yakawanda
y-m-65-08.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvakatarisa chokwadi chokuti nzvimbo yevara ine sarudzo dzakawanda kupfuura nzvimbo yenhamba.
y-m-65-08.s.s1.o.b: Ndi (가). Ine nzvimbo imwe yenhamba yakawanda
y-m-65-08.s.s1.r.b: Izvi zvakatarisa chete huwandu hwenzvimbo kwete rudzi rwenzvimbo.
y-m-65-08.s.s1.o.c: Zvakafanana. Izvi zvinoitika nokuti pane nzvimbo 5 muzvose zviviri
y-m-65-08.s.s1.r.c: Izvi zvakatarisa chete huwandu hwose hwenzvimbo uye zvakashayikwa kuti huwandu hwesarudzo hunosiyana kubva panzvimbo kuenda kune imwe.
y-m-65-08.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza huwandu hwenzvimbo dzamavara L nehuwandu hwenzvimbo dzenhamba D kuti huwandu hwenyaya dzepasiwedhi huve pakati pemiriyoni 1 nemiriyoni 5, kusanganisira. Gadzira zvimiro 2 zvakasiyana.
y-m-65-08.s.s2.hint.0: Chinja L rimwe panguva imwe kubva pa 0 kusvika pa 5 uye utsvage huwandu hwenyaya.
y-m-65-08.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga kana zvimwe zvimiro zvabviswa nokuda kwomuganho wepasi kana wepamusoro wemhando.
y-m-65-08.s.s2.ok.c1: Huwandu hwenzvimbo inhamba dzizere dziri 0 kana kupfuura.
y-m-65-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Huwandu hwenzvimbo hunofanira kuva nhamba dzizere dziri 0 kana kupfuura.
y-m-65-08.s.s2.ok.c3: Huwandu hwenyaya huri pakati pemiriyoni 1 nemiriyoni 5, kusanganisira.
y-m-65-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Huwandu hwenyaya hauri pakati pemiriyoni 1 nemiriyoni 5.
y-m-65-08.s.s2.explain: Kana L=3 ndi 1,757,600, uye kana L=4 ndi 4,569,760. L=2 inopa 676,000, isingakwani, uye L=5 inopa 11,881,376, iri pamusoro pemiriyoni 5.
y-m-65-08.s.s2.because.prompt: Kuchimiro chimwe chawakasarudza, nyora kuti wakawana sei huwandu hwose hwemapasiwedhi.
y-m-65-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tanga wanyora huwandu hwesarudzo dzenzvimbo yega yega.
y-m-65-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora here zvakarurama huwandu hwesarudzo dzenzvimbo yega yega?
y-m-65-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Unonzwisisa here kuti sei uchiwanza pane kuwedzera?
y-m-65-08.s.s2.because.model.0: Nzvimbo 3 dzamavara dzega dzine sarudzo 26 uye nzvimbo 2 dzenhamba dzega dzine sarudzo 10, saka ndi 26×26×26×10×10=1,757,600.
y-m-65-08.s.s2.because.model.1: Unowanza nokuti kusarudza nzvimbo yega yega hakukanganisi dzimwe. Kuwanza 26 nguva ina uye 10 kamwe kunopa 456,976×10=4,569,760.
y-m-65-08.s.s3.prompt: Muchimiro (L, D)=(3, 2), kana mutemo uchichinjwa kuva "nzvimbo 3 dzamavara dzinogona kuva chero papi pakati penzvimbo 5," huwandu hwenyaya hunova nguva dzingani dzekutanga? (Mapasiwedhi anosiyana nokuti nzvimbo dzamavara nenzvimbo dzenhamba dzakaiswa papi chete anoverengwa semapasiwedhi akasiyana.)
y-m-65-08.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora kurongwa kushoma kwenzvimbo dzingaiswa nzvimbo dzamavara.
y-m-65-08.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana kurongwa kwenzvimbo kwakasiyana kungapa pasiwedhi imwe chete kaviri.
y-m-65-08.s.s3.r.a: Izvi zvakaona kurongwa kwenzvimbo semarudzi maviri.
y-m-65-08.s.s3.r.b: Izvi zvakatora huwandu hwenzvimbo dzenzvimbo dzamavara se 5.
y-m-65-08.s.s3.r.c: Nzira dzokusarudza nzvimbo dzenzvimbo 3 dzamavara ndi 10 uye hadzipindirani.
y-m-65-08.s.s3.r.d: Izvi zvakaverenga kaviri nokufungawo nhevedzano yokurongwa kwenzvimbo.
y-m-65-08.s.s3.explain: Huwandu hwenzira dzokusarudza nzvimbo dzenzvimbo 3 dzamavara pakati penzvimbo 5 ndi 10, uye kurongwa kwenzvimbo kwakasiyana kunopa mapasiwedhi akasiyana, saka ndi 1,757,600×10=17,576,000 nzira.

y-m-65-07.title: Macandies akafanana nemacandies akasiyana
y-m-65-07.topic: Kugovera zvinhu zvakafanana nekugovera zvinhu zvakasiyana
y-m-65-07.goal: Tonga kuti huwandu hwenyaya hunochinja zvichienderana nekuti zvinhu zvakafanana kana kusiyana, uye gadzira uye uverenge, usina kusiya, migovero inogutsa mamiriro.
y-m-65-07.material:
Unopa macandies ose 6 kuvanhu vatatu, 갑, 을, ne 병. Tanga wafunga nyaya apo mumwe munhu anogona kusagamuchira candy.
(가) Macandies ose anoratidzika akafanana zvachose.
(나) Macandies ose ndeema flavors akasiyana.
y-m-65-07.thinking.1: Nyora nyaya dzose dzinogutsa mamiriro usina kusiya
y-m-65-07.prereq.2: Mamiriro: vanhu 갑, 을, ne 병 vanhu vatatu vanosiyaniswa kubva kune mumwe, uye macandies ose anopiwa
y-m-65-07.s.s1.prompt: Huwandu hwenyaya mu (가) ne (나) hunoenzaniswa sei?
y-m-65-07.s.s1.hint.0: Mu (가), tarisa kana unongoda kusarudza "ndiani anowana zvakawanda sei."
y-m-65-07.s.s1.hint.1: Mu (나), verenga nzira dzekusarudza kuti candy imwe neimwe inoenda kuna ani, candy imwe panguva.
y-m-65-07.s.s1.o.a: (가) ine zvakawanda. Macandies anoratidzika akafanana, saka sarudzo yakasununguka.
y-m-65-07.s.s1.r.b: Vakaona kuti kana macandies achisiyaniswa, kunyange kugovera kumwe chete kunoparadzana kuita mhedzisiro dzakawanda.
y-m-65-07.s.s1.o.c: Nyaya mbiri dzakafanana. Nekuti pane macandies 6 mune dzose mbiri.
y-m-65-07.s.s1.r.c: Vakatarisa huwandu hwemacandies chete uye havana kufunga kana macandies achisiyaniswa.
y-m-65-07.s.s1.explain: Mu (나), candy imwe neimwe inoenda kumunhu mumwe wevatatu, saka pane nzira 3^6=729; mu (가), musanganiswa wehuwandu hunowanikwa ne 갑, 을, ne 병 chete ndiwo unoverengwa, saka pane nzira 28.
y-m-65-07.s.s2.prompt: (가) Macandies ose akafanana, uye unoapa kuti vanhu vatatu vose vagamuchire candy 1 kana kupfuura uye pasina anogamuchira kupfuura 3. Gadzira migovero 4 yakasiyana yehuwandu (x, y, z) hunogamuchirwa ne 갑, 을, ne 병. (Kana vanhu vakasiyana, ndiwo mugovero wakasiyana.)
y-m-65-07.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga washanda kuti munhu anowana zvakawanda zvakanyanya anogona kuva nemacandies mangani mu x+y+z=6.
y-m-65-07.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga wanyora seti dzose dzenhamba nhatu dzine sum 6 nenhevedzano yehukuru, wozobvisa dzisingakodzeri mamiriro.
y-m-65-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Munhu mumwe kana kupfuura haagamuchiri chero.
y-m-65-07.s.s2.explain: Migovero inogoneka ndiyo nzira 6 dzinobva mukuchinja kurongeka kwe (1,2,3) nenzira 1 ye (2,2,2), nzira 7 dzose.
y-m-65-07.s.s3.prompt: Pane migovero mingani dzose inogutsa mamiriro ari pamusoro (mumwe nemumwe anowana 1 kana kupfuura, 3 kana pasi)?
y-m-65-07.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora seti dzose dzenhamba nhatu dzine sum 6, imwe neimwe 1 kana kupfuura, nenhevedzano yehukuru, wozochengeta dzinokodzera muganhu we3 chete.
y-m-65-07.s.s3.hint.1: Kune imwe neimwe yawakachengeta, verenga zvakaparadzana kuti pane nzira dzakasiyana dzakawanda sei dzekuiisa kuna Gap, Eul ne Byeong.
y-m-65-07.s.s3.r.a: Izvi zvinoverenga musanganiswa wenhamba chete, pasina kusiyanisa Gap, Eul ne Byeong. Vanhu vakasiyana zvinoreva mugovero wakasiyana.
y-m-65-07.s.s3.r.c: Izvi zvinoverenga kugoverwa kuvanhu ne (2,2,2) zvose.
y-m-65-07.s.s3.r.d: Izvi zvakatarisa chete mamiriro e "1 kana kupfuura" uye zvakashayikwa muganho we 3.
y-m-65-07.s.s3.explain: Pane nzira 3!=6 dzokugovera (1,2,3) ku 갑, 을, ne 병 uye nzira 1 ye (2,2,2), saka nzira 7. Dai mamiriro ari "1 kana kupfuura" chete, dzaizova nzira 10.

y-m-65-03.title: Pane vanhu vaviri mukirasi vane zuva rokuzvarwa rimwe chete here?
y-m-65-03.topic: Zviitiko zvinoenderana nokuwanza mikana: mukana wepeya imwe kana kupfuura inowirirana
y-m-65-03.goal: Tsanangura kuti sei mukana we 'imwe kana kupfuura' unotsvakwa kubva pakumbotarisa zvakapesana pane kuverenga zvakananga, uye utonge kuti mukana unochinja sei kana pfungwa dzichichinja.
y-m-65-03.material: Mukirasi ine vadzidzi 30, unoda kuziva kana paine vadzidzi vaviri kana kupfuura vane zuva rokuzvarwa rimwe chete. Modheru: zuva rokuzvarwa romudzidzi wose rimwe pamazuva 365, zuva rega rega rine mukana wakaenzana, uye vadzidzi havakanganisani. Gore harifungwi.
y-m-65-03.prereq.3: Mamiriro: zuva rokuzvarwa rimwe pamazuva 365 (kusingasanganisiri Kukadzi 29), zuva rega rega rine mukana wakaenzana, uye mazuva okuzvarwa evadzidzi anofungidzirwa kuva akazvimirira kubva kune mumwe nomumwe
y-m-65-03.s.s1.prompt: Ngatifungei nhanho nenhanho pamusoro pemukana wokuti pane peya imwe kana kupfuura yevadzidzi vane zuva rokuzvarwa rimwe chete.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.hint.0: Pachikamu chega chega, nyora mumutsetse mumwe kuti kufungidzira kwako kwakavakirwa paruzivo rupi.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kana ruzivo rutsva rwakasimba zvakakwana kuchinja kufungidzira kwako kana kuti rwunogona kuramba rwakafanana.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Mukirasi ye 30, unofunga kuti ndezvikuru zvakadini kuti pane peya imwe kana kupfuura ine zuva rokuzvarwa rimwe chete? Hausati waverenga.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ndeipi iri padhuze zvikuru nepfungwa yako?
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Pano, mhinduro ipi neipi ipfungwa chete. Chinokosha ndechokuti vanhu 30 vanoita mapeya 435.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Izvi zvakafungidzira kuti mazuva 365 akawanda zvakanyanya kupfuura vanhu 30, saka havangobvumirani.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Izvi zvakafungidzira kuti kubvumirana kunoitika dzimwe nguva.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Izvi zvakafunga kuti huwandu hwemapeya hwakakura.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Iyi ndiyo mhedzisiro yokuverenga mukana kumapoka madiki. Vanhu 5: inenge 2.7%, vanhu 10: inenge 11.7%, vanhu 20: inenge 41.1%, vanhu 23: inenge 50.7%.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Mukana unowedzera sezvo huwandu hwevanhu huchikura, uye watopfuura 50% kuvanhu 23, saka kuvanhu 30 wakakura kupfuura iyoyo.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Izvi zvakafungidzira kuti kuwedzera kunokura nomutsetse wakananga sezvo vanhu vachiwedzerwa.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Izvi zvakaenderera mberi nomafambiro okukwira anopfuura 50% kuvanhu 23.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Izvi zvakafungidzira kuti mukana unogona kudzikira kunyange vanhu vachiwedzerwa.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.2.info:
Mukana wokuti vanhu vose 30 vane mazuva okuzvarwa akasiyana ndi (365/365)×(364/365)×...×(336/365), unenge 29.4%. Saka mukana wokuti pane peya imwe kana kupfuura inowirirana ndi 1 bvisa izvi, inenge 70.6%.
Ikozvino funga nezvechokwadi. Mazuva okuzvarwa evadzidzi chaiwo haapararirwi zvakaenzana mumwaka uye anounganidzwa mumwedzi yakati.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kana mazuva okuzvarwa akaunganidzwa, mukana wepeya imwe kana kupfuura inowirirana unoenzaniswa sei ne 70.6%?
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Nyaya yakaenzana ine kubvumirana kushoma zvikuru. Kana pane kuunganidzwa, mukana wokuti zuva rimwe chete ribvumirane wakafanana kana mukuru. Saka 70.6% inogona kunge iri pasi pekukosha chaiko.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Izvi zvakafungidzira kuti kuverenga kwakafanana kunyange modheru ichichinja.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Izvi zvakafungidzira kuti nokuunganidzwa mazuva akafanana anobvumirana kazhinji.
y-m-65-03.s.s1.reflect: Tarisa shure kuti wakagadzirisa sei pfungwa yako yekutanga mushure memhedzisiro yokuverenga neshanduko dzepfungwa, kana ruzivo rupi rwakakubvumira kuichengeta.
y-m-65-03.s.s2.prompt: Tsanangura kuti sei unoshandisa "zvose zvakasiyana" pane kuverenga zvakananga mukana we "peya imwe kana kupfuura inowirirana".
y-m-65-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kana ukanyora zvakananga nyaya dzine peya inowirirana, nyora zvimiro zvishoma zvakasiyana zvingaita.
y-m-65-03.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa kana nyaya ye "zvose zvakasiyana" chimiro chimwe chete.
y-m-65-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Chikonzero chako chokuti sei kuverenga zvakananga kwakaoma chakananga here?
y-m-65-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakabatanidza here chikonzero chokubvisa kubva pa 1 nechokwadi chokuti mikana inowedzera kuita 1?
y-m-65-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakafunga here kana nzira imwe chete inoshandawo kuhuwandu hwevanhu kunze kwe 30?
y-m-65-03.s.s2.model.0: Nyaya dzine peya inowirirana dzine zvimiro zvakawanda zvakanyanya, se peya imwe chete inowirirana, mapeya maviri anowirirana, kana vanhu vatatu vanowirirana, saka zvakaoma kuverenga zvakananga. Zvakapesana, "zvose zvakasiyana," ine chimiro chimwe chete, saka inogona kutsvakwa zvakananga nokuwanza, uye kubvisa kubva pa 1 kunoita kuti ive nyore.
y-m-65-03.s.s2.model.1: Huwandu hwemikana ndi 1, saka unogona kutsvaga mukana wokuti hapana peya yakafanana uye uubvise kubva pa 1. Unongoda kutsvaga nyaya yezvose zvakasiyana, saka kuverenga kuri nyore zvakanyanya.
y-m-65-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Haishandisi mashoko okuti "chiitiko chinopikisa," asi ipfungwa imwe chete.

y-m-65-01.title: Kana "sarudza vanhu vaviri" ichigona kureva zvinhu zviviri zvakasiyana
y-m-65-01.topic: Permutations ne combinations: mutemo wekutora mhedzisiro yakasarudzwa seakafanana
y-m-65-01.goal: Tsanangura kuti kunyange "sarudza 2 pa 5" imwechete, huwandu hwezviitiko hunochinja kana mutemo wekusiyanisa mhedzisiro wakasiyana, uye uwane mutsetse une kukanganisa kwekuverenga kaviri mumhinduro.
y-m-65-01.material:
Vanhu vaviri vanosarudzwa kubva pa ma candidates 5 (가, 나, 다, 라, 마). Munhu mumwe nemumwe anogona kusarudzwa kamwe chete.
Mamiriro ㄱ: Vanhu vaviri vakasarudzwa vanotora zvinzvimbo zvakasiyana, class president ne vice president.
Mamiriro ㄴ: Vanhu vaviri vakasarudzwa vanotora basa rimwechete pamwe chete, class representatives.
Unoda kuenzanisa huwandu hwezviitiko mumamiriro maviri.
y-m-65-01.thinking.2: Gadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso uye utsanangure mutemo wekusiyanisa
y-m-65-01.prereq.0: Chiratidzo che H2/H3 mubasa iri i danho rekunetsa rakapiwa kugadzira chete. Hazvireve kuti curriculum inopa chidzidzo ichi kugiredhi iroro.
y-m-65-01.prereq.2: Mamiriro: ma candidates 5 ese i vanhu vakasiyana, uye hapana anogona kusarudzwa kaviri
y-m-65-01.s.s1.prompt: Unofunga chii ikozvino nezve huwandu hwezviitiko mumamiriro maviri ㄱ ne ㄴ?
y-m-65-01.s.s1.hint.0: Mu ㄱ, nyora zvakaparadzana mhedzisiro "가 i president uye 나 i vice president" nemhedzisiro "나 i president uye 가 i vice president."
y-m-65-01.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga kuti vanhu vaviri vamwechete (가, 나) vanonyorwa semhedzisiro nenzira dzingani mu ㄴ.
y-m-65-01.s.s1.o.a: ㄱ ine zvakawanda. Nekuti kana chinzvimbo chichichinja, chinoverengwa semhedzisiro yakasiyana
y-m-65-01.s.s1.o.b: Huwandu hwezviitiko hwakafanana mumamiriro maviri, sezvo vanhu 2 vanosarudzwa. Nekuti huwandu hwevanhu vakasarudzwa hwakafanana
y-m-65-01.s.s1.r.b: Yakatarisa huwandu hwevanhu vakasarudzwa chete uye haina kutarisa chiyero chekusiyanisa mhedzisiro.
y-m-65-01.s.s1.o.c: ㄴ ine zvakawanda. Nekuti mabasa akafanana, saka vanhu vakawanda vanogona kusarudzwa
y-m-65-01.s.s1.r.c: Yakaverenga mabasa ari akafanana sekureva kuti range yevanhu vanogona kusarudzwa i yakakura.
y-m-65-01.s.s1.explain: Mu ㄱ, (가 i president, 나 i vice president) ne (나 i president, 가 i vice president) i mhedzisiro dzakasiyana, asi mu ㄴ i vamiriri vaviri vamwechete, saka i mhedzisiro imwechete. ㄱ ine zviitiko 20 uye ㄴ ine zviitiko 10.
y-m-65-01.s.s2.prompt: Mudzidzi akagadzirisa mamiriro ㄴ seizvi. Sarudza mutsetse wakaipa.
y-m-65-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa kana mutsetse wega wega uchitaura kuti mhedzisiro yakaverengwa ka kangani.
y-m-65-01.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora iwe pachako kuti (가, 나) ne (나, 가) imwe neimwe inoonekwa kangani mukuwanza kwemhinduro iyi.
